title: Menu | Harbour & Hearth
description: Breakfast, lunch, bakes and drinks at Harbour & Hearth, Saltmarsh Quay.
heading: Our menu
intro: Simple food, done well. Everything's made here unless we say otherwise. Ask at the counter for today's specials.
allergensNote: Allergens: our food is made in a small kitchen that handles gluten, nuts, dairy, eggs, sesame and more. We can't promise anything is allergen-free. Please tell us about any allergies before you order and we'll talk you through the options.
